patch_description:
This crossover combines the high tracking accuracy and low lag of the adaptive constant-velocity Kalman design with the lower false-reversal behavior of exponentially weighted sliding-window smoothing.

The enhanced path uses a robust adaptive Kalman level/slope estimator as the primary real-time tracker. Its output is then passed through a lightweight trend-aware consensus stage: an exponentially weighted window estimate provides stable local context, while a predictive alpha-beta correction preserves current trend direction and avoids ordinary moving-average delay. The blend is adaptive: when the Kalman estimate and local trend estimate agree, smoothing is increased to suppress noise-induced reversals; when they diverge during a genuine transition, the Kalman estimate dominates to retain responsiveness.

The basic mode retains its original behavior and output shape, but uses a cumulative-sum implementation for efficient O(n) moving averages.
